rationale: This is a re-normalization of the archived "Unabsorbed External Financing" signal (itself close to the well-documented net-external-financing anomaly of Bradshaw-Richardson-Sloan), and the bounded form actually degrades information because any firm with negligible R&D/advertising is pinned at ±1 regardless of financing magnitude, turning the measure into a near-sign indicator for the large non-intangible universe.

Replacing the asset-scaled maturity spread with a genuine maturity-composition ratio is a substantive (not cosmetic) refinement of the archived "Research Duration Mismatch" result that plausibly strips out the leverage-level and size channels, though the COALESCE-to-zero choice lumps debt-free firms into the "safe" tail and the underlying rollover-risk premium is itself a partly published channel.

The diagnostic motivation (gross repayments contain refinancing noise) is sound, but scaling debt by contemporaneous assets makes NEG(DELTA(debt/at)) mechanically increasing in asset growth, so the signal loads positively on a known negative-return anomaly and works against the stated expected sign; deflating the debt change by lagged assets would fix this.

This is a thinly disguised variant of the archived "Innovation-Narrative Issuance" (rising/accelerating R&D interacted with net equity issuance, which failed at fmb -1.37 with wrong-signed alpha), and a 3-period TS_RANK yields only three distinct conditioning values, so it is neither a materially different mechanism nor a meaningfully finer conditioner.

Share-count growth is the canonical net share issuance anomaly (Pontiff-Woodgate; Daniel-Titman composite issuance), so any strength here is likely rediscovery rather than a cross-theme effect, and the intangible-intensity weight merely re-runs the archived "Knowledge-Backed Net Repurchase" construction with csho substituted for cash flows.

The scale-contamination diagnosis of the archived "Intangible Financing Instability" null is reasonable, but VOL of a sign over only three observations produces at most three distinct values, giving an extremely coarse, clumpy conditioning variable that will destabilize portfolio tails and is unlikely to overturn a prior result that was a decisive null in both metrics.
